vuln.name: Chinese Bank Card Number Disclosed
vuln.description: A response body contains what matches the format of a Chinese bank card number (16-19 digits with a valid Luhn checksum).
vuln.impact: Disclosure of bank card numbers is a financial-data privacy breach and may enable fraud.
vuln.recommendation: Remove the card numbers from the response. Tokenize or mask PAN data and comply with PCI-DSS handling requirements.
